citations.claim: body 1 west of wall before crossing
body 1 centre jumped across wall 0 between steps 80 and 81 at ~598 m/s
body 1 east of wall after crossing

explanation: Head-on elastic collision with 100:1 mass ratio (20 vs 0.2) produced a non-physical slingshot: light body went from -62 m/s to -598 m/s while heavy body dropped 59.7 to 4.3 m/s, violating momentum conservation. At ~598 m/s the per-substep displacement (~0.28m with 70 substeps) exceeds the 0.1m wall thickness, so the centre crossed through wall 0 between steps 80 and 81.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 80 and 81

vision_note: A large blue body moves right toward a thin vertical wall with a tiny red body squeezed between it and the wall through steps 78-80. At step 81 the tiny red body is suddenly on the far side of the wall while the large body remains on the near side.
